div.div:
Legend
[Type: technology] = C4 element caption. Outlined groups = architectural domains.
0 = User sign-in; 1–5 = request sequence; 5′ = alternative failure response.
Solid filled arrow = caller to callee. Dashed arrow = auxiliary policy query. Yellow note = example ID token attributes / architectural comments.
Normal token return is folded into Step 1. All relationships have one caller-to-callee arrowhead.

Normal token return is folded into Step 1. All relationships have one caller-to-callee arrowhead.
